senses.en: A tool with pointed prongs for picking up food
A place where a road or path divides
Divide into separate branches or directions

ex.en: She picked up a carrot with her fork.
ex.zh: 她用餐叉叉起了一块胡萝卜。

ex.en: Where a rural path forks, clear directions can prevent visitors from entering environmentally sensitive areas.
ex.zh: 在乡间小路分叉处提供清晰指引，可以防止游客进入生态敏感区域。

col: a knife and fork｜一副刀叉
a fork in the road｜道路岔口
tip: 道路forks表示分叉；a fork in the road指岔路口。

senses.en: to complete something or reach its end
the final part or end of something
the appearance or texture of a completed surface

ex.en: I'll finish washing the dishes before we go.
ex.zh: 我们出门前，我会把碗洗完。

ex.en: Students who finish their assignments early have more time to review feedback and improve their understanding.
ex.zh: 提前完成作业的学生有更多时间查看反馈并加深理解。

tip: 表示做完某事用finish doing，不用finish to do。

senses.en: To begin doing something or cause something to begin.
To make a machine operate, or begin operating.
The moment or place where something begins.

ex.en: We started cooking dinner as soon as we got home.
ex.zh: 我们一到家就开始做晚饭。

ex.en: Schools should start teaching financial skills early so that young people can make informed decisions about money.
ex.zh: 学校应尽早开始教授理财技能，让年轻人能在充分了解情况后作出财务决定。

col: at the start of｜在……开始时
make a fresh start｜重新开始
tip: start doing与start to do通常都可表示开始做某事。

senses.en: to give official permission for an activity
an official document permitting an activity or ownership

ex.en: You need a license to drive on public roads.
ex.zh: 你需要有驾驶执照才能在公共道路上开车。

ex.en: Authorities should license childcare providers carefully to ensure that facilities meet appropriate safety and quality standards.
ex.zh: 主管部门应审慎审批托育机构的经营许可，确保设施符合相应的安全和质量标准。

col: license someone to do something｜许可某人做某事
apply for a license｜申请许可证
tip: 英式名词写 licence、动词写 license；美式均用 license。

senses.en: A tool that uses ink to write or draw.
A small enclosed area where animals are kept.
To write a letter, story or other piece of writing.

ex.en: Could you lend me a pen for this form?
ex.zh: 你能借我一支笔填这张表吗？

ex.en: Some students prefer using a pen because writing by hand helps them organise their ideas.
ex.zh: 有些学生更喜欢用笔，因为手写有助于他们整理思路。

tip: pen泛指墨水笔；钢笔可明确说fountain pen。

senses.en: Not high in position, amount, level, or degree.
Feeling sad or lacking confidence.
At a small height, level, or volume.

ex.en: The low shelf is easy for children to reach.
ex.zh: 这个低矮的架子很方便孩子们取东西。

ex.en: Low wages can prevent essential workers from finding affordable housing close to their places of employment.
ex.zh: 低工资可能让从事必要服务的劳动者难以在工作地点附近找到负担得起的住房。

tip: 价格低用low，东西便宜用cheap。

senses.en: used before a noun to ask or show who owns something
used to ask who something belongs to

ex.en: Whose umbrella is dripping water all over the floor?
ex.zh: 谁的雨伞把水滴得满地都是？

ex.en: Children whose parents read regularly at home may develop a stronger interest in books.
ex.zh: 父母经常在家阅读的孩子可能会对书籍产生更浓厚的兴趣。

tip: whose表示所属；who’s是who is或who has的缩写。

senses.en: Someone who studies in the same class as you.

ex.en: My classmate lent me a pencil before the lesson.
ex.zh: 上课前，我的同班同学借给我一支铅笔。

ex.en: Working with classmates on group projects can help students develop communication and problem-solving skills.
ex.zh: 与同班同学合作完成小组项目可以帮助学生培养沟通和解决问题的能力。

col: a former classmate｜以前的同班同学
help a classmate｜帮助同班同学
tip: classmate指同班同学，schoolmate指同校同学。

senses.en: a place, usually in a city, where animals of many kinds are kept so that people can go to look at them

ex.en: The road to the zoo turns off here.
ex.zh: 通向动物园的路由这儿拐弯。

ex.en: The parrots in the zoo are popping all the time.
ex.zh: 动物园里的鹦鹉一直在生小鹦鹉。

senses.en: Letters and parcels, or the system used to deliver them.
To send something by mail or share it publicly.
A job or position in an organisation.

ex.en: A parcel arrived in the post this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上寄来了一个包裹。

ex.en: Local authorities should post regular updates online to keep residents informed about changes to public services.
ex.zh: 地方政府应定期在网上发布最新消息，让居民了解公共服务的变化。

col: apply for a post｜申请职位
tip: 邮寄义中，英式常用post，美式常用mail。

senses.en: a group working together or playing a sport together
to join someone to work together, usually with up

ex.en: Our team celebrated with pizza after winning the match.
ex.zh: 我们队赢得比赛后，吃披萨庆祝了一番。

ex.en: Working in a team helps students develop communication skills that are essential for future employment.
ex.zh: 团队合作有助于学生培养未来就业所必需的沟通能力。

tip: 英式英语中team可接单数或复数谓语。

senses.en: Exactly alike, or referring to one particular thing rather than another.
The very thing already mentioned, or something exactly like it.

ex.en: We take the same bus to school every morning.
ex.zh: 我们每天早上乘同一班公交车上学。

ex.en: Students from different backgrounds should have the same opportunities to access high-quality education and develop their talents.
ex.zh: 不同背景的学生应享有同样的机会，接受优质教育并发展自己的才能。

tip: 通常用the same；比较时用the same as。

senses.en: used as the past tense of ‘can’ to say what someone was able to do or was allowed to do in the past

ex.en: I could do it, he mused.
ex.zh: 我能做这件事，他沉思着。

senses.en: Someone who arranges meetings and handles office communication.

senses.zh: 协会或组织的书记；干事
senses.en: An official managing an organisation's records and routine business.
A senior government official responsible for a particular department.

ex.en: The secretary arranged a meeting for tomorrow afternoon.
ex.zh: 秘书安排了明天下午的会议。

ex.en: A school secretary often provides essential support by coordinating appointments and communicating with parents throughout the day.
ex.zh: 学校秘书常常通过安排会面及全天与家长沟通，提供不可或缺的支持。

tip: 既可指办公室秘书，也可指某些政府部长。

senses.en: A particular area, position, or location.
To put something in a particular position.
A space available for someone to sit, study, or participate.

ex.en: This shady spot is a lovely place for a picnic.
ex.zh: 这处阴凉的地方很适合野餐。

ex.en: Urban planners should place public facilities near residential areas to make essential services accessible to everyone.
ex.zh: 城市规划者应将公共设施设在住宅区附近，让所有人都能方便地获得基本服务。

col: a university place｜大学录取名额
tip: take place表示发生或举行，不用被动语态。

senses.en: a large shop selling food and other everyday goods

ex.en: We stopped at the supermarket to buy milk and rice.
ex.zh: 我们顺路去超市买了牛奶和大米。

ex.en: Large supermarkets can offer lower prices, but their expansion may threaten independent shops in smaller communities.
ex.zh: 大型超市能提供更低的价格，但其扩张可能威胁小型社区里的独立商店。

tip: 在超市购物常说shop at a supermarket。

senses.en: a sound, especially one that is loud or unwanted

ex.en: The noise outside woke me before my alarm rang.
ex.zh: 外面的噪音在闹钟响之前就把我吵醒了。

ex.en: Prolonged exposure to traffic noise can affect sleep quality and reduce the wellbeing of urban residents.
ex.zh: 长期接触交通噪音会影响睡眠质量，降低城市居民的身心健康水平。

tip: 泛指噪音时不可数；指某个具体声响可用a noise。

senses.en: A set of steps connecting different levels of a building.

ex.en: We carried the heavy suitcase up the narrow stairs.
ex.zh: 我们把沉重的行李箱沿着狭窄的楼梯搬了上去。

ex.en: Public buildings should provide lifts alongside stairs to ensure equal access for people with limited mobility.
ex.zh: 公共建筑应在楼梯之外配备电梯，确保行动不便者也能平等使用。

col: a flight of stairs｜一段楼梯
tip: stairs是复数，谓语用复数；一段楼梯用a flight of stairs。

senses.en: In, from, or relating to the north.

ex.en: My grandparents live in a quiet northern village.
ex.zh: 我的祖父母住在北方一个安静的村庄。

ex.en: Northern regions often face higher heating costs, making energy efficiency particularly important for local households.
ex.zh: 北部地区的供暖费用往往较高，因此提高能源效率对当地家庭尤其重要。

tip: northern是形容词，常置于region、coast等名词前。

senses.en: an area of land used for crops or farm animals
a particular area of study or work
an area of ground used for playing a sport

ex.en: We watched sheep grazing in the field behind our cottage.
ex.zh: 我们看着羊群在小屋后面的牧场上吃草。

ex.en: Research in the field of renewable energy could create employment opportunities and reduce dependence on fossil fuels.
ex.zh: 可再生能源领域的研究可以创造就业机会，并减少对化石燃料的依赖。

tip: 表示研究或工作领域时，常用in the field of。

senses.en: a room where students are taught

ex.en: Sunlight filled the classroom as we opened our books.
ex.zh: 我们打开书本时，阳光洒满了教室。

ex.en: A well-designed classroom should provide adequate lighting, comfortable furniture, and enough space for students to work together.
ex.zh: 设计良好的教室应有充足的照明、舒适的家具，以及供学生合作学习的足够空间。

tip: in the classroom强调教室内；in class强调上课中。

senses.en: a mark showing achievement, or a level of quality
a school year level, especially in the American system
to assess work or sort things by quality

ex.en: I got a good grade on my science project.
ex.zh: 我的科学课项目得了个好成绩。

ex.en: Teachers should grade assignments consistently so that students understand how their performance is assessed across different subjects.
ex.zh: 教师应按一致的标准给作业评分，让学生了解不同学科如何评估他们的表现。

col: get a good grade｜取得好成绩
tip: 表示年级时多用于美式英语；英式英语常用year。

senses.en: to prepare food by heating it, or become ready through heating
someone who prepares and cooks food

ex.en: I usually cook vegetable soup when the weather turns cold.
ex.zh: 天气变冷时，我通常会煮蔬菜汤。

ex.en: Teaching children to cook simple meals can encourage healthier eating habits and greater independence later in life.
ex.zh: 教孩子做简单饭菜，可以培养更健康的饮食习惯，让他们日后更加独立。

col: cook from scratch｜从原材料开始做饭
a good cook｜做饭好吃的人
cook over low heat｜用小火烹调
tip: cook可指厨师；cooker在英式英语中指炉灶。

senses.en: used for a male person receiving an action or following a preposition

ex.en: My brother forgot his lunch, so I brought it to him.
ex.zh: 我哥哥忘了带午饭，所以我给他送了过去。

ex.en: When a student struggles with reading, teachers can support him through regular practice and constructive feedback.
ex.zh: 当一名男学生阅读有困难时，教师可以通过定期练习和建设性反馈帮助他。

col: give him a chance｜给他一个机会
tip: he作主语，him作动词或介词的宾语。

senses.en: To change position or go to live somewhere else.
To make someone feel a strong emotion.
An action taken to achieve a particular result.

ex.en: Could you move this chair closer to the window?
ex.zh: 你能把这把椅子挪到靠窗一点的位置吗？

ex.en: The decision to expand public transport is a positive move towards reducing urban congestion.
ex.zh: 扩大公共交通的决定是缓解城市拥堵的一项积极举措。

col: move forward｜向前移动；取得进展
tip: moving指令人感动的，moved指感到感动的。

senses.en: To clean something using water, often with soap.
To carry or move something through flowing water.
An act of cleaning with water.

ex.en: Please wash your hands before you help prepare dinner.
ex.zh: 帮忙准备晚餐前，请先洗手。

ex.en: Schools should teach children to wash their hands properly to reduce the spread of infectious diseases.
ex.zh: 学校应教孩子正确洗手，以减少传染病的传播。

col: give something a wash｜把某物洗一洗
tip: wash强调用水洗；clean泛指清洁，不一定用水。

senses.en: having plenty of bright sunlight
cheerful and positive in character or mood

ex.en: We ate breakfast on the sunny balcony this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上，我们在阳光充足的阳台上吃了早餐。

ex.en: Regions with sunny climates can generate substantial amounts of electricity through well-planned solar energy projects.
ex.zh: 阳光充足的地区可以通过规划合理的太阳能项目产生大量电力。

tip: sunny强调阳光足，不一定表示气温高。

senses.en: a flower with layered petals, often growing on thorny stems
past tense of rise: moved upwards or increased

ex.en: She placed a single rose in a glass vase.
ex.zh: 她把一枝玫瑰插进了玻璃花瓶。

ex.en: Demand for public transport rose sharply after the city introduced cheaper fares and more frequent services.
ex.zh: 该市降低票价并增加班次后，公共交通需求大幅上升。

col: a bunch of roses｜一束玫瑰
tip: rose也可作rise的过去式；过去分词是risen。

senses.en: Coming after sixth and before eighth in an ordered sequence.
One of seven equal parts of something.

ex.en: Our new flat is on the seventh floor.
ex.zh: 我们的新公寓在七楼。

ex.en: By the seventh week of the course, students were able to analyse basic scientific data independently.
ex.zh: 到课程第七周时，学生已能独立分析基本的科学数据。

tip: 序数词前通常用the；已有物主限定词时不用the。

senses.en: The solid surface of the earth.
Reasons or evidence supporting a belief, decision, or action.
To prevent an aircraft from flying.

ex.en: We spread a blanket on the ground beneath a tree.
ex.zh: 我们在树下的地面上铺了一条毯子。

ex.en: Planting trees helps the ground retain moisture and reduces the risk of soil erosion.
ex.zh: 植树有助于土地保持水分，并降低水土流失的风险。

tip: 表示理由常用复数grounds；ground也是grind的过去式。

senses.en: the number equal to ten times ten

ex.en: The hall can hold about a hundred people.
ex.zh: 这个大厅大约能容纳一百人。

ex.en: Several hundred residents participated in the survey about proposed improvements to local parks and cycle routes.
ex.zh: 数百名居民参与了关于当地公园和自行车路线改进提案的调查。

tip: 具体数词后用hundred；泛指数百用hundreds of。

senses.en: Someone who guides or directs a group of people.
A person or organization ahead of others in a field.

ex.en: Our group leader showed us the safest mountain path.
ex.zh: 我们的领队给我们指明了最安全的山路。

ex.en: Effective leaders encourage employees to share ideas rather than simply follow instructions without question.
ex.zh: 高效的领导者鼓励员工分享想法，而不是毫无疑问地服从指令。

tip: leader指领导者；leadership指领导能力或领导层。

senses.en: an account of real or imagined events
a report about an event in the news
one level of a building, in American English

ex.en: Grandma told us a funny story about her childhood.
ex.zh: 奶奶给我们讲了一个她童年的趣事。

ex.en: Sharing a personal story can help students understand historical events from a more human perspective.
ex.zh: 分享个人经历可以帮助学生从更有人情味的角度理解历史事件。

tip: 楼层英式写storey，美式写story；高度不固定。

senses.en: The part of your face used for smelling and breathing.
The front part of an aircraft or similar vehicle.

ex.en: My nose turned red in the cold wind.
ex.zh: 我的鼻子在冷风中冻红了。

ex.en: Wearing a mask over the nose and mouth can reduce exposure to airborne dust.
ex.zh: 戴口罩遮住口鼻可以减少吸入空气中的灰尘。

col: the nose of an aircraft｜飞机机头
tip: 擤鼻涕用blow your nose，不用clean。

senses.en: a building where Christians gather to worship
Christian religious worship attended as a service
an organized group of Christians sharing beliefs and practices

ex.en: The old church has beautiful windows and a stone tower.
ex.zh: 这座古老的教堂有漂亮的窗户和一座石塔。

ex.en: Preserving a historic church can protect local heritage while providing opportunities for education and tourism.
ex.zh: 保护历史悠久的教堂既能保护当地文化遗产，也能为教育和旅游创造机会。

tip: go to church指做礼拜；go to the church指去教堂。

senses.en: in addition to something already mentioned

ex.en: My sister plays tennis and also enjoys swimming.
ex.zh: 我姐姐打网球，也喜欢游泳。

ex.en: Public libraries provide free books, but they also offer valuable spaces for community learning.
ex.zh: 公共图书馆提供免费书籍，也为社区学习提供宝贵的空间。

col: not only ... but also｜不仅……而且
tip: 通常放实义动词前、be动词后；不是连词。

senses.en: Make or become full
Occupy an empty position or meet a particular need

ex.en: Please fill the jug with water for our guests.
ex.zh: 请把水壶装满水，给客人们喝。

ex.en: Local training programmes can help fill vacancies in essential services such as healthcare and education.
ex.zh: 地方培训项目可以帮助填补医疗和教育等基本服务领域的职位空缺。

col: fill in a form｜填写表格
fill a vacancy｜填补职位空缺
tip: fill A with B表示用B装满A；be filled with表示充满。

senses.en: A soft seat with a back for several people

ex.en: We curled up on the sofa after dinner.
ex.zh: 晚饭后，我们蜷坐在沙发上。

ex.en: A comfortable sofa in a shared lounge can encourage residents to spend more time together.
ex.zh: 公共休息室里一张舒适的沙发可以鼓励住户多聚在一起。

col: sit on the sofa｜坐在沙发上
tip: 坐在沙发上用on the sofa，不用in。

senses.en: Coming after the eighth and before the tenth.
One of nine equal parts of something.

ex.en: Our new apartment is on the ninth floor.
ex.zh: 我们的新公寓在九楼。

ex.en: By the ninth year of the conservation programme, several endangered species had begun to recover.
ex.zh: 到保护项目实施的第九年，几种濒危物种的数量已开始回升。

tip: nine变ninth时去掉e；序数词前通常用the。

senses.en: a large road vehicle that carries passengers
to transport people somewhere by bus

ex.en: We caught the last bus home after the concert.
ex.zh: 音乐会结束后，我们赶上了回家的末班公交车。

ex.en: More frequent bus services could reduce traffic congestion and improve access to employment in outer suburbs.
ex.zh: 增加公交班次可以缓解交通拥堵，并改善远郊居民的就业出行条件。

tip: by bus不加冠词；take a bus需加冠词。

senses.en: a unit of length equal to 2.54 centimetres
to move very slowly over a short distance

ex.en: The shelf is an inch wider than the cupboard.
ex.zh: 这个架子比橱柜宽一英寸。

ex.en: During rush hour, buses inch through crowded streets, making public transport less attractive to commuters.
ex.zh: 高峰时段，公交车在拥挤的街道上缓慢行驶，降低了公共交通对通勤者的吸引力。

tip: 英寸符号为″；作动词表示一点点移动。

senses.en: Having a high temperature.
Having a strong taste that burns your mouth.
Attracting a lot of interest or discussion.

ex.en: Be careful; the soup is still very hot.
ex.zh: 小心，汤还很烫。

ex.en: As summers become increasingly hot, cities need more shaded public spaces to protect residents from heat.
ex.zh: 随着夏季越来越炎热，城市需要更多有遮阴设施的公共空间来保护居民免受高温影响。

tip: 形容食物时可指“烫”或“辣”，需结合语境。

senses.en: Enjoy an activity or take part in a game
Perform music or a role, or make a recording run
A story written for actors to perform

ex.en: The children played with wooden blocks on the floor.
ex.zh: 孩子们在地板上玩木制积木。

ex.en: Schools should provide safe outdoor spaces where children can play and develop essential social skills.
ex.zh: 学校应提供安全的户外空间，让孩子们玩耍并培养重要的社交技能。

col: play a role in｜在…中发挥作用
put on a play｜上演一部戏剧
tip: 球类前通常不加冠词；乐器前通常用the。

senses.en: a man whose job is to deliver letters and parcels

ex.en: The postman left a parcel beside our front door.
ex.zh: 邮递员把一个包裹放在了我们家门旁。

ex.en: In remote villages, a postman may provide an essential link between residents and public services.
ex.zh: 在偏远村庄，邮递员可能是连接居民与公共服务的重要纽带。

col: work as a postman｜当邮递员
the postman's round｜邮递员的投递路线
tip: 英式常用；美式常用mail carrier，且不限定性别。

senses.en: to put your hand or another body part against something
the sense of feeling things through skin, or physical contact
to make someone feel a strong, often tender emotion

ex.en: Please don't touch the pan; it is still hot.
ex.zh: 请别碰锅，它还很烫。

ex.en: Digital communication helps families stay in touch, even when work or study separates them across countries.
ex.zh: 即使工作或学习使家人分居不同国家，数字通信也能帮助他们保持联系。

tip: 保持联系用keep in touch with someone。

senses.en: having the colour of fresh snow or milk
the colour of fresh snow or milk
the clear part of an egg that turns white when cooked

ex.en: She wore a white cotton shirt to the picnic.
ex.zh: 她穿着一件白色棉衬衫去野餐。

ex.en: Painting roofs white can help buildings reflect sunlight and reduce the energy needed for cooling.
ex.zh: 把屋顶刷成白色有助于建筑物反射阳光，并减少制冷所需的能源。

tip: egg white指蛋清；蛋黄是yolk。

senses.en: the meal you eat at the start of the day

ex.en: I usually have breakfast before taking the bus.
ex.zh: 我通常吃完早餐再去坐公交车。

ex.en: Schools that provide a healthy breakfast may help students concentrate better during morning lessons.
ex.zh: 提供健康早餐的学校可能有助于学生在上午的课堂上更加专注。

col: a balanced breakfast｜营养均衡的早餐
tip: 泛指吃早餐用have breakfast，不加冠词。

senses.en: a thing that can be seen or touched
to express disagreement with something
the aim of an action or activity

ex.en: A shiny object was lying beneath the sofa.
ex.zh: 沙发下面有个闪闪发亮的东西。

ex.en: Many residents object to the proposed airport expansion because it could increase noise pollution.
ex.zh: 许多居民反对拟议中的机场扩建，因为这可能加剧噪声污染。

col: object to a proposal｜反对一项提议
the object of the exercise｜这项活动的目的
tip: 名词重音在前，动词在后；object to后接名词或动名词。

senses.en: Fine thread produced by silkworms, or fabric made from it.

ex.en: She wrapped a soft silk scarf around her neck.
ex.zh: 她把一条柔软的丝巾围在脖子上。

ex.en: Traditional silk production provides employment in rural communities while preserving skills passed down through generations.
ex.zh: 传统丝绸生产为农村社区提供就业机会，同时保留了代代相传的技艺。

tip: silk通常不可数；silky指柔滑如丝，不一定是丝制。

senses.en: used to give advice or say what is right
used to say something is expected or likely
used with have to describe an unfulfilled duty or expectation

ex.en: You should take an umbrella because it looks cloudy.
ex.zh: 你应该带把伞，因为天看起来阴沉沉的。

ex.en: Governments should invest in affordable public transport to reduce congestion and improve urban air quality.
ex.zh: 政府应该投资于价格实惠的公共交通，以缓解拥堵并改善城市空气质量。

col: should be able to｜应该能够
tip: 情态动词，后接动词原形；should have done常指本该做却未做。

senses.en: costing little money or less than usual
of poor quality and little value

ex.en: We found a cheap café near the train station.
ex.zh: 我们在火车站附近找到了一家价格实惠的咖啡馆。

ex.en: Cheap public transport can improve access to employment and reduce dependence on private cars in large cities.
ex.zh: 价格低廉的公共交通能改善大城市居民的就业可达性，并减少对私家车的依赖。

col: a cheap alternative｜便宜的替代选择
tip: cheap有时暗示质量差；中性表达可用inexpensive。

senses.en: For everyone to use, see, or know about.
Provided or controlled by the government.
Ordinary people in society considered as a group.

ex.en: The public garden stays open until sunset every day.
ex.zh: 这座公共花园每天开放到日落。

ex.en: Investment in public transport can improve access to employment while reducing dependence on private cars.
ex.zh: 投资公共交通可以让人们更方便地上班，同时减少对私家车的依赖。

tip: the public指公众；in public指在公共场合。

senses.en: At the side of someone or something.

ex.en: Please leave your wet boots beside the door.
ex.zh: 请把你的湿靴子放在门旁边。

ex.en: Creating walking paths beside urban rivers can encourage physical activity and improve residents' access to nature.
ex.zh: 在城市河流旁修建步道可以鼓励身体活动，并让居民更容易亲近自然。

col: sit beside someone｜坐在某人旁边
tip: beside表示“在旁边”；besides表示“此外；除……之外”。

senses.en: Most important or largest among others.
A large pipe or cable supplying water, gas, or electricity.

ex.en: The main entrance is beside the little coffee shop.
ex.zh: 正门就在那家小咖啡馆旁边。

ex.en: One main reason for urban migration is the wider range of employment opportunities available in cities.
ex.zh: 人们迁往城市的一个主要原因是城市提供的就业机会更多。

tip: 形容词通常放在名词前；主要地用mainly。

senses.en: feeling strong displeasure about something unfair, wrong, or unpleasant

ex.en: He felt angry when someone damaged his bicycle.
ex.zh: 有人弄坏了他的自行车，他感到很生气。

ex.en: Residents became angry about the council's decision to close the only library in their neighbourhood.
ex.zh: 市政委员会决定关闭社区唯一的图书馆，居民们对此感到愤怒。

tip: 生某人的气用angry with；因某事生气用about。

senses.en: A particular way of doing something.
An organized and systematic approach to an activity.

ex.en: This method keeps my herbs fresh for several days.
ex.zh: 这个方法能让我的香草保鲜好几天。

ex.en: Teachers should adapt their teaching methods to meet the varied needs of students in mixed-ability classrooms.
ex.zh: 教师应调整教学方法，以满足能力水平不同的学生的多样化需求。

tip: 常用a method of/for doing sth表示做事的方法。

senses.en: An unexpected event that causes injury or damage.
Something that happens without being planned or intended.

ex.en: Luckily, nobody was hurt in the accident outside our house.
ex.zh: 幸好，我们家外面发生的事故没有造成人员受伤。

ex.en: Better street lighting can reduce the risk of accidents involving cyclists and pedestrians at night.
ex.zh: 改善街道照明可以降低夜间涉及骑车人和行人的事故风险。

col: a road accident｜道路交通事故
tip: by accident表示无意中，反义短语是on purpose。

senses.en: The dark part of each day when the sun is down.

ex.en: We watched the stars from our balcony last night.
ex.zh: 昨晚，我们在阳台上看星星。

ex.en: Excessive artificial light at night can disrupt sleep patterns and affect the behaviour of urban wildlife.
ex.zh: 夜间过多的人造光会扰乱睡眠规律，并影响城市野生动物的行为。

col: a good night's sleep｜一夜好眠
tip: 泛指夜间用at night；last night前不加介词。

senses.en: above something or from one side to the other
more than a particular amount, age, or level
finished or no longer happening

ex.en: A small bird flew over the garden wall.
ex.zh: 一只小鸟飞过了花园的围墙。

ex.en: Over half of the residents surveyed supported plans to create more green spaces in their neighbourhood.
ex.zh: 受访居民中有超过一半支持在社区内增设绿地的计划。

col: all over the world｜世界各地
tip: over可指越过或超过；be over表示结束。

senses.en: a game where teams kick a ball into opposing goals
an American game involving carrying, throwing, and kicking an oval ball

ex.en: We play football in the park every Saturday morning.
ex.zh: 我们每周六早上都在公园踢足球。

ex.en: Local football clubs can strengthen community relationships by bringing together people from different social backgrounds.
ex.zh: 地方足球俱乐部能够聚集不同社会背景的人，从而增进社区联系。

tip: 英式football指足球；美式通常指美式橄榄球。

senses.en: Up to now, especially in questions and negative statements.
But, despite what has just been stated.
Used to emphasize a further increase or addition.

ex.en: I haven't finished dinner yet, so please wait.
ex.zh: 我还没吃完晚饭，请等一下。

ex.en: Renewable energy is becoming cheaper, yet many countries still depend heavily on fossil fuels.
ex.zh: 可再生能源正在变得更便宜，然而许多国家仍严重依赖化石燃料。

tip: 表示“还未”常用于否定句末；疑问句中可表示“已经”。

senses.en: a long reptile without legs
to move or extend along a winding path

ex.en: A small snake slid quietly through the dry grass.
ex.zh: 一条小蛇悄悄滑过干草丛。

ex.en: Although snakes often cause fear, they help maintain ecological balance by controlling populations of rodents and other animals.
ex.zh: 虽然蛇常令人恐惧，但它们通过控制啮齿动物及其他动物的数量，帮助维持生态平衡。

tip: 作动词表示蜿蜒，常搭配through或along。

senses.en: Recently produced or picked, and not preserved or stale.
Clean, cool, and pleasant, especially when describing air.
New or different from what existed or was used before.

ex.en: I bought fresh strawberries from the market this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上我在市场买了新鲜草莓。

ex.en: Access to fresh fruit and vegetables is essential for improving diets in low-income urban communities.
ex.zh: 让城市低收入社区居民能获得新鲜果蔬，对改善其饮食至关重要。

tip: fresh water指淡水；fresh air指新鲜空气。

senses.en: Form a picture or idea of something in your mind.
Think something is probably true without being certain.

ex.en: Imagine living in a little house beside the sea.
ex.zh: 想象一下住在海边一栋小房子里的情景。

ex.en: Urban planners must imagine how future residents will use shared spaces before designing new neighbourhoods.
ex.zh: 城市规划者在设计新社区之前，必须设想未来居民将如何使用公共空间。

tip: imagine后接动名词，不接to do。

senses.en: ordinary, usual, or happening every day

ex.en: Describe it in ordinary everyday language.
ex.zh: 用一般的日常语言把它描述一下。

col: the problems of everyday life｜日常生活中的问题
a simple, everyday object｜简单的日常物品

senses.en: One or the other of two; each of two sides.
One or the other of two people or things.
Also not, used after a negative statement.

ex.en: You can borrow either umbrella; both are dry.
ex.zh: 两把伞你随便借哪把都行，都是干的。

ex.en: Students can choose either vocational training or university education, depending on their interests and career goals.
ex.zh: 学生可以根据自己的兴趣和职业目标，选择职业培训或大学教育。

col: either side｜两边中的任一边；两边各自
either of them｜他们两者中的任一个
tip: either…or…表二选一；否定句末either表“也不”。

senses.en: used to say that an unpleasant experience has ended and can be forgotten
done, used, or experienced before now

ex.en: You mustn’t think about it. It’s all in the past now.
ex.zh: 你千万不要再想那件事，现在一切都过去了。

senses.en: Something discussed, studied, or taught.
Affected by something or dependent on a condition.
To make someone experience something, especially something unpleasant.

ex.en: Science was my favourite subject when I was younger.
ex.zh: 我小时候最喜欢的学科是科学。

ex.en: Schools should give creative subjects sufficient attention because they help students develop imagination and problem-solving skills.
ex.zh: 学校应给予创意类学科充分重视，因为这些学科有助于培养学生的想象力和解决问题的能力。

col: subject someone to stress｜使某人承受压力
tip: 动词重音在后：/səbˈdʒekt/；常用subject A to B。

senses.en: Belonging or relating to one particular person.
Concerning someone's private life rather than public matters.

senses.zh: 针对个人的；人身攻击的
senses.en: Directed at someone's character rather than their ideas or actions.

ex.en: Please keep your personal belongings close while boarding the train.
ex.zh: 上火车时，请将个人物品放在身边。

ex.en: Online services should protect personal information and explain clearly how they collect and use customer data.
ex.zh: 在线服务应保护个人信息，并清楚说明如何收集和使用客户数据。

tip: personal指个人的；personnel指全体员工，注意拼写。

senses.en: The joint where your leg bends in the middle.

ex.en: She bent her knee gently before starting the exercise.
ex.zh: 开始锻炼前，她轻轻弯了弯膝盖。

ex.en: Regular low-impact exercise can strengthen the muscles around the knee and help maintain mobility in older adults.
ex.zh: 经常进行低冲击运动可以增强膝关节周围的肌肉，帮助老年人保持行动能力。

tip: 词首k不发音；复数knees读作/niːz/。

senses.en: A short written message or record of useful information.
To notice something or record it in writing.
A single musical sound or a symbol representing it.

ex.en: I left a note beside your breakfast bowl.
ex.zh: 我在你的早餐碗旁留了一张便条。

ex.en: Students who take notes in their own words may develop a deeper understanding of complex material.
ex.zh: 用自己的话记笔记的学生可能会对复杂的学习材料形成更深入的理解。

tip: 记笔记用take notes；note that后接完整句子。

senses.en: used when we are both doing and receiving an action
used to emphasize that we do something, not others

ex.en: We saw ourselves reflected in the clear lake.
ex.zh: 我们看到了自己映在清澈湖水中的倒影。

ex.en: By involving ourselves in community projects, we can develop practical skills and strengthen local relationships.
ex.zh: 通过参与社区项目，我们可以培养实用技能并增进邻里关系。

tip: by ourselves可指独自，也可指不靠别人。

senses.en: a structure with walls and a roof
the activity of constructing houses or other structures

ex.en: Our apartment building has a garden on the roof.
ex.zh: 我们住的公寓楼屋顶上有一个花园。

ex.en: Improving insulation in older buildings can reduce energy consumption and lower heating costs for residents.
ex.zh: 改善老旧建筑的隔热性能可以减少能源消耗，降低居民的取暖费用。

tip: 指建筑物时可数，指建造活动时通常不可数。

senses.en: the ability to store and recall information or experiences
something from the past that you remember
the part of a computer that stores information

ex.en: My grandmother has an excellent memory for faces.
ex.zh: 我奶奶特别善于记住别人的长相。

ex.en: Regular physical exercise may improve memory and help older adults maintain their independence for longer.
ex.zh: 经常锻炼可能改善记忆力，帮助老年人更长久地保持独立生活的能力。

tip: 记忆力通常不可数；一段段回忆用memories。

senses.en: An explanation or meeting that first presents someone or something.
The act of bringing something into use or a place.

ex.en: After a brief introduction, we started cooking together.
ex.zh: 简短介绍之后，我们开始一起做饭。

ex.en: The introduction of electric buses could reduce air pollution in densely populated urban areas.
ex.zh: 引入电动公交车可以减少人口密集城区的空气污染。

col: an introduction to｜对……的介绍；……入门
tip: 入门介绍常用introduction to；引进某物用of。

senses.en: a professional who examines and treats teeth and gums

ex.en: The dentist checked my teeth and recommended a softer toothbrush.
ex.zh: 牙医检查了我的牙齿，并建议我用更软的牙刷。

ex.en: Regular visits to a dentist can prevent minor dental problems from developing into serious health conditions.
ex.zh: 定期看牙医可以防止小的牙齿问题发展成严重的健康问题。

col: a qualified dentist｜有执业资格的牙医
tip: dentist指牙医；the dentist's可指牙医诊所。

senses.en: Making or having a strong sound that is easily heard.
With a strong sound that is easily heard.

ex.en: A loud crash woke everyone in the house.
ex.zh: 一声巨响惊醒了屋里的所有人。

ex.en: Frequent exposure to loud music can damage hearing, particularly among young people who use headphones.
ex.zh: 经常接触高音量的音乐可能损伤听力，使用耳机的年轻人尤其如此。

col: loud and clear｜响亮而清楚地
tip: read out loud指读出声；loudly也可表示大声地。

senses.en: a single part or quantity within a larger whole
a device or separate part of a machine
a group organised for a particular task

ex.en: We finished the first unit before our lunch break.
ex.zh: 我们在午休前学完了第一个单元。

ex.en: Each unit of the course introduces practical skills that students can apply in the workplace.
ex.zh: 这门课程的每个单元都介绍学生可以在工作中运用的实用技能。

col: a unit of measurement｜计量单位
an intensive care unit｜重症监护病房
tip: 表示计量单位时常用a unit of，后接所计量的事物。

senses.en: To go back, or give something back.
The act of coming or going back.
Money or benefits gained from an investment or activity.

ex.en: Please return these library books before you go away.
ex.zh: 请在离开之前归还这些图书馆的书。

ex.en: Investment in early childhood education can generate a substantial economic return by improving future employment opportunities.
ex.zh: 投资幼儿教育可以通过改善未来就业机会，带来可观的经济回报。

col: return to work｜重返工作岗位
tip: return已含“回”的意思，通常不再加back。

senses.en: On the side opposite the right.
Towards or on the side opposite the right.
Still available or remaining after others have gone or been used.

ex.en: I carry my shopping bag in my left hand.
ex.zh: 我用左手提购物袋。

ex.en: Drivers should check their mirrors carefully before turning left, especially where cyclists share the road.
ex.zh: 驾驶员左转前应仔细查看后视镜，尤其是在与骑行者共用道路的地方。

tip: 也是 leave 的过去式和过去分词；表剩余时置于名词后。

senses.en: on one occasion only
at a time in the past
as soon as something happens or becomes true

ex.en: I water this little cactus once every two weeks.
ex.zh: 我每两周给这株小仙人掌浇一次水。

ex.en: Once reliable public transport becomes available, more commuters may choose to leave their cars at home.
ex.zh: 一旦有了可靠的公共交通，更多通勤者可能会选择不开车出门。

tip: once引导将来时间从句时，通常用一般现在时。

senses.en: No longer alive
No longer working, often because power has run out
Completely or exactly, used for emphasis

ex.en: We removed the dead flowers from the balcony pots.
ex.zh: 我们清除了阳台花盆里枯死的花。

ex.en: Leaving dead trees in forests can support biodiversity by providing habitats for insects and small animals.
ex.zh: 将枯树留在森林中能为昆虫和小动物提供栖息地，从而促进生物多样性。

tip: dead是状态，die是动作，death是名词。

senses.en: Something specific that shows what a general idea means
A person or action that others can learn from or copy

ex.en: Could you give me an example of a healthy breakfast?
ex.zh: 你能给我举一个健康早餐的例子吗？

ex.en: Public buildings can set an example by using renewable energy and reducing unnecessary water consumption.
ex.zh: 公共建筑可以通过使用可再生能源和减少不必要的用水来树立榜样。

tip: for example用于举例；set an example意为树立榜样。

senses.en: Practical use of scientific knowledge, especially through tools and machines.

ex.en: New technology lets us control the lights from our phones.
ex.zh: 新技术让我们可以用手机控制灯光。

ex.en: Investment in clean technology can reduce industrial pollution while creating skilled jobs in emerging sectors.
ex.zh: 投资清洁技术可以减少工业污染，同时在新兴领域创造技术岗位。

tip: 泛指科技时不可数；多种具体技术可用technologies。

senses.en: An insect with broad, often colourful wings and a thin body.
A swimming stroke with both arms moving forward together above water.

ex.en: A yellow butterfly landed gently on my sleeve.
ex.zh: 一只黄色蝴蝶轻轻落在我的袖子上。

ex.en: Planting native flowers in urban gardens can support butterfly populations and contribute to greater local biodiversity.
ex.zh: 在城市花园中种植本地花卉可以帮助维持蝴蝶种群，并提升当地的生物多样性。

tip: 复数为butterflies；蝶泳义通常不可数。

senses.en: a disease, or the state of being unwell

ex.en: She missed our picnic because of a sudden illness.
ex.zh: 她突然生病，没能参加我们的野餐。

ex.en: Early access to medical care can prevent minor illnesses from developing into serious health problems.
ex.zh: 及早获得医疗服务可以防止小病发展为严重的健康问题。

col: recover from an illness｜病后康复
tip: 泛指生病时不可数；指具体疾病时可数。

senses.en: A piece of writing in a newspaper, magazine, or website.
A single item, especially one belonging to a particular group.
A word such as a, an, or the before a noun.

ex.en: I read an interesting article about growing tomatoes indoors.
ex.zh: 我读了一篇关于室内种植番茄的有趣文章。

ex.en: The article examines how access to green spaces influences mental health in densely populated cities.
ex.zh: 这篇文章探讨了在密集人口城市中，绿地的可及性如何影响心理健康。

col: an article of clothing｜一件衣物
tip: 一件衣物可说an article of clothing。

senses.en: The activity of moving through water using your body.

ex.en: We go swimming at the indoor pool every Saturday.
ex.zh: 我们每周六都去室内泳池游泳。

ex.en: Regular swimming can improve physical fitness while placing relatively little stress on the joints.
ex.zh: 经常游泳可以增强体质，同时对关节造成的压力相对较小。

tip: 表示运动时不可数；去游泳用go swimming。

senses.en: to move your body rhythmically, usually to music
rhythmic movement to music, or an event for dancing

ex.en: We danced in the kitchen while dinner was cooking.
ex.zh: 晚饭还在做的时候，我们在厨房里跳起了舞。

ex.en: Traditional dance can strengthen community identity while offering younger generations a connection to their cultural heritage.
ex.zh: 传统舞蹈能够增强社区认同感，同时让年轻一代与自身文化遗产建立联系。

col: dance to music｜随着音乐跳舞
tip: 随音乐跳舞用dance to music，介词用to。

senses.en: a portable fabric shelter supported by poles and ropes

ex.en: We pitched our tent beside a quiet lake.
ex.zh: 我们在一个宁静的湖边搭起帐篷。

ex.en: Visitors who sleep in a tent should follow campsite rules to minimise their impact on local wildlife.
ex.zh: 住帐篷的游客应遵守营地规定，尽量减少对当地野生动物的影响。

col: put up a tent｜搭起帐篷
tip: “搭帐篷”用pitch或put up a tent。

senses.en: Belonging to or connected with the person speaking.

ex.en: I left my umbrella beside the front door.
ex.zh: 我把我的伞放在前门旁边了。

ex.en: In my view, cities should prioritise affordable housing rather than invest heavily in prestigious construction projects.
ex.zh: 在我看来，城市应优先提供可负担住房，而非大量投资于彰显声望的建设项目。

col: to my surprise｜令我惊讶的是
tip: my后须接名词；mine可独立使用，表示“我的”。

senses.en: Having good things happen by chance.
Believed to bring good fortune.

ex.en: We were lucky to catch the last bus home.
ex.zh: 我们很幸运，赶上了回家的末班公交车。

ex.en: Although some entrepreneurs benefit from lucky opportunities, long-term business success usually requires careful planning and consistent effort.
ex.zh: 虽然一些创业者受益于偶然的机遇，但企业的长期成功通常需要周密规划和持续努力。

col: a lucky break｜好运带来的机会
tip: “有幸做某事”用be lucky to do something。

senses.en: Used to connect contrasting ideas or correct an earlier statement.
Except for someone or something.

ex.en: The bag looks small, but it holds everything I need.
ex.zh: 这个包看起来小，却装得下我需要的所有东西。

ex.en: Public transport can reduce traffic congestion, but services must be reliable enough to attract regular users.
ex.zh: 公共交通能缓解交通拥堵，但服务必须足够可靠，才能吸引经常乘坐的乘客。

col: not only ... but also ...｜不仅……而且……
tip: although与but通常不在同一句中成对使用。

senses.en: a period of sixty minutes
the times when someone works or a service operates

ex.en: The walk to the lake took us an hour.
ex.zh: 我们走到湖边花了一个小时。

ex.en: Reducing working hours may improve employee wellbeing without necessarily lowering overall productivity in the workplace.
ex.zh: 缩短工作时间可能改善员工的身心健康，而不一定降低工作场所的整体生产率。

tip: h不发音，所以说an hour，而不是a hour。

senses.en: Twelve o'clock in the middle of the day.

ex.en: Let's meet outside the library at noon tomorrow.
ex.zh: 我们明天中午在图书馆外见吧。

ex.en: Outdoor workers should avoid intense physical activity around noon, when temperatures and sunlight can be particularly strong.
ex.zh: 户外工作者应避免在正午前后进行高强度体力活动，此时气温可能很高，阳光也可能特别强烈。

tip: 说at noon，不说in noon；正午是12 p.m.。

senses.en: making you laugh or smile
unusual or difficult to explain

ex.en: That funny story made everyone at the table laugh.
ex.zh: 那个好笑的故事逗得桌边的人都笑了。

ex.en: Teachers sometimes use funny examples to make difficult concepts more memorable and encourage students to participate.
ex.zh: 教师有时会用有趣的例子，让复杂概念更容易记住，并鼓励学生参与。

col: find something funny｜觉得某事好笑
tip: funny侧重好笑或奇怪；fun侧重令人愉快、有趣。

senses.en: a recorded story or sequence of moving images for watching

ex.en: We watched a funny movie after dinner last night.
ex.zh: 昨晚晚饭后，我们看了一部有趣的电影。

ex.en: Movies can introduce audiences to unfamiliar cultures, although they sometimes reinforce stereotypes rather than challenge them.
ex.zh: 电影可以向观众介绍陌生文化，不过有时也会强化刻板印象，而非打破它们。

col: go to the movies｜去看电影
tip: movie偏美式，英式常用film；the movies可指电影院。

senses.en: A publication containing news, articles, and advertisements, usually printed daily.
An organization that produces and publishes news in a newspaper.

ex.en: My grandfather reads the newspaper while eating breakfast.
ex.zh: 我爷爷一边吃早饭一边看报纸。

ex.en: Local newspapers provide valuable coverage of community issues that national media may overlook.
ex.zh: 地方报纸对全国性媒体可能忽略的社区问题提供了有价值的报道。

tip: 一份报纸用a newspaper；作包装材料时可不可数。

senses.en: Away from the inside of a place, or from home.
No longer burning, shining, or working.
Available to the public or no longer secret.

ex.en: We went out for a walk after dinner.
ex.zh: 晚饭后我们出去散步了。

ex.en: When a new research report comes out, journalists should examine its evidence before reporting its conclusions.
ex.zh: 新的研究报告发布时，记者应先审查其证据，再报道其结论。

tip: out 常作副词；在某物外面可用 outside。

senses.en: Opposing someone or something, or competing with them.
Touching or supported by a surface.
For protection from something harmful or unwanted.

ex.en: Our team is playing against the neighbours this afternoon.
ex.zh: 今天下午我们队要和邻居们比赛。

ex.en: Some residents are against airport expansion because they fear increased noise and damage to nearby habitats.
ex.zh: 一些居民反对机场扩建，因为他们担心噪声增加以及附近栖息地遭到破坏。

tip: against是介词，后接名词、代词或动名词。
